title: PRAXIS: Graph-Grounded Tacit Knowledge for Domain Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents have achieved strong performance on general software engineering tasks, yet struggle with domain-specific code generation. We identify the root cause as the agent's lack of tacit knowledge, including domain-specific business rules, interface contracts, and operational conventions that developers internalize through practice but never document. This knowledge is deeply buried beneath the domain code, dispersed across code entities and their dependency relations, and invisible to the agent that lacks it. These properties make tacit knowledge inherently difficult to retrieve or learn. In this work, we propose PRAXIS, a framework that enables agents to systematically extract, represent, and reuse tacit knowledge for domain code generation. translated_title: PRAXIS：面向领域代码生成的图基隐性知识
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19784v1 公告类型：新 摘要：LLM代理在通用软件工程任务上表现出色，但在特定领域的代码生成方面却面临困难。我们确定根本原因在于代理缺乏隐性知识，包括领域特定的业务规则、接口契约和操作惯例，这些知识是开发者在实践中内化但从未记录下来的。这些知识深埋在领域代码之下，分散在代码实体及其依赖关系中，对于缺乏它的代理来说是不可见的。这些特性使得隐性知识本质上难以检索或学习。在这项工作中，我们提出PRAXIS，一个框架，使代理能够系统地提取、表示和重用隐性知识以进行领域代码生成。PRAXIS通过模拟目标代码库中的人类开发工作流来获取隐性知识，将其提炼为结构化单元，组织在代码依赖图上，并主动提供这些知识。
tldr: PRAXIS通过模拟人类开发工作流，从代码库中提取隐性知识并将其组织为图结构，使LLM代理能够有效生成领域特定代码。
en_tdlr: PRAXIS extracts tacit knowledge from codebases by simulating human workflows and organizes it into graph structures, enabling LLM agents to effectively generate domain-specific code.
